## Results not yet available

The language model's results appear here once the coding script has been run. The script, `data-raw/run_ai_coding.R`, runs a language model (locally, through Ollama), so it is run once by the author and its output is saved in the book's repository; this section then compares the model's coding with the hand coding (accuracy, Cohen's kappa, and the confusion matrix), with the keyword method, and with the model's own second attempt.
